note: Rival dialogue bank (Beta 0.6 R5): 528 authored lines for 8 personalities, from the notes pack RIVAL_DIALOGUE_BANK.md. Species lines are built at runtime (src/core/rivals/bank.ts): an opener plus a type line, plus a category line. {mon} is the species name.

champion-chaser.voice: Cocky, quick, always measuring. Compliments come out as insults.
open: So that's your {mon}.
A {mon}, huh? Cute. I'll remember it when I'm Champion.
Your {mon} keeps looking at me. It knows who's winning.

type.normal: Normal-types. Nothing special, which is about what I expected from you.
type.fire: Fire burns bright and burns out. I don't.
type.water: Water goes wherever the ground lets it. I pick my own road.
type.electric: Fast. Not faster than me, but fast.
type.grass: Grass grows slowly. I don't have that kind of time.
type.ice: Ice breaks if you hit it right. I always hit it right.
type.fighting: Good. Something that can actually throw a punch.
type.poison: Poison's for people who can't win in one hit.
type.flying: It flies. So it'll have a good view of me pulling ahead.
type.psychic: If it reads minds, it already knows how this ends.
type.bug: A Bug-type. You're really making this easy.
type.rock: Hard-headed. We'd get along, if it were on the right team.
type.dragon: A Dragon? Fine. Now it's a real race.
type.dark: Fights dirty. I respect that more than I should.
type.steel: Tough to dent. I like a challenge.
type.fairy: Pretty, and nastier than it looks. Like my win record.

cat.first: {mon} hasn't even evolved. Call me when it does.
cat.middle: {mon}'s halfway there. So are you. I'm not.
cat.final: A fully evolved {mon}. Finally, something worth beating.
cat.single: {mon} is what it is. No surprises. I like knowing what I'm beating.
cat.form: A special form? Showing off already. That's my job.
cat.titan: That's a serious Pokémon. Don't waste it.

catch: You caught it? I was going to. I let you have it.
Nice throw. Mine's better, but nice.
One more for your team. You'll need all six against me.
event: You stopped for this? I'd have been at the next Gym by now.
Fine, I'll help. Faster we finish, faster I beat you.
Don't tell anyone I stayed for this.
interrupt: Hold it. Whatever you're doing can wait. I can't.
Bad time? Good. Let's battle.
I've been looking for you, and I don't look for people.
pseudo: First one out picks the prize. Try to keep up.
You're in here too? Then it's a race.
I've already been through half of this. Want directions? No? Good.
gym: This Leader's mine first. You can have what's left.
I already have this badge. Took me one try.
Don't lose in there. I want you in decent shape when I beat you.
elite: Four of them, then the title. I've been counting since the first route.
If you fall here, I'm not waiting.
The Elite Four are a formality. You're the one I think about.
champion: That chair's mine. Try not to scuff it.
Whoever wins in there, I'm next. Make it worth my time.
I wanted it to be you and me at the end. Don't tell me I said that.
blessing: A Legendary picked you? It hasn't met me yet.
Nice trinket. Does it win battles for you, or do you still have to do that part?
Whatever's watching over you, tell it to watch closely. I'm about to be worth seeing.
mythical: What is that following you? No. Don't tell me. I'll find my own.
It won't even look at me. Fine. I'm not looking at it either.
You promised it something, didn't you. You'd better keep it. I hate people who don't finish things.
static: The sky's cracked and you're staring at it. I'm going in. Try to keep up.
Whatever comes out of that, I'm beating it before you do.
That thing isn't from here. Good. I was running out of things to beat.
second: Get up. You don't get to lose to anyone but me.
pity: I wasn't trying. Obviously. Take this and stop looking at me like that.
You've had a rough start. That's all I'm saying. Here.
won: See you at the League. I'll be the one on the plaque.
That's one. I'm keeping count.
You were closer than I'll ever admit.
lost: Fluke. Next time I'm not holding anything back.
...Fine. You're better today. Today.
Good. I need somebody worth chasing.

bitter-challenger.voice: Clipped and sore. Says the hard thing first. Cares more than the words admit.
open: {mon}. Of course.
I've seen what your {mon} does. I haven't forgotten.
You and that {mon}. Always in my way.

type.normal: Ordinary. And it still gets the wins. Typical.
type.fire: Everyone loves a Fire-type. Nobody asks what it burns.
type.water: It just flows around every problem. Must be nice.
type.electric: Quick. Everything comes quick to you.
type.grass: It sits in the sun and gets stronger. I had to work.
type.ice: Cold. Good. At least it's honest.
type.fighting: It hits hard. So do I, now.
type.poison: Poison is patient. So am I.
type.ground: It'll take a lot to move it. I've got a lot.
type.flying: It gets to look down on everyone. Like you.
type.psychic: If it's reading me, I hope it hurts.
type.bug: People step on Bug-types. Then one day they can't.
type.ghost: It should be gone and it isn't. I know the feeling.
type.dragon: A Dragon. Somebody handed you that, didn't they.
type.dark: It fights the way the world actually works.
type.steel: Nothing gets through to it. Lucky.

cat.first: {mon} is small and you still beat people with it. I hate that.
cat.final: {mon} got to become everything it could be. Not everyone does.
cat.single: {mon} never changes. It doesn't have to. Must be nice.
cat.form: A rare form. Naturally. You'd have one.
cat.titan: With a Pokémon like that, anyone could win. Remember that.

catch: It chose your Ball. They always do.
Take it. I'll catch something that has to earn its place.
Another one who likes you. Count them while you can.
event: You're helping. Of course you are. Somebody's watching, I suppose.
I'll do my part. Don't thank me.
Nobody stopped for me. I'm stopping anyway. Don't make it strange.
interrupt: Stop. I've waited long enough.
You don't get to be busy. Not with me standing here.
I trained through the night for this. You can spare ten minutes.
pseudo: I got here on my own. You?
Stay out of my way in here and I'll stay out of yours.
If something goes wrong in this place, I'm not carrying you. ...Probably.
gym: They gave you that badge. I'm going to take mine.
The Leader said you were 'promising'. Didn't say anything about me.
Win in there. I don't want to hear you lost to someone else.
elite: Four people who've never heard my name. That changes today.
I didn't come this far to watch you from the door.
If you go through them, I'm right behind you. I always was.
champion: Everyone thinks it'll be you. Go and prove them right, so I can prove them wrong.
I wanted this more than you did. Remember that when you're in there.
...Don't lose. Not to them.
blessing: Of course something chose you. Something always does.
A blessing. I got here with nothing watching over me. Remember that.
Keep your god. I'll keep my own two hands.
mythical: It trusts you. They always do. Don't waste it.
I heard that story as a kid. I stopped believing it. Guess that was my mistake.
If you break whatever you promised it, I'll know. It'll be gone.
static: Something's wrong with the sky, and somehow I bet it's about you.
It came because of how you fight. Think about that.
I'm not afraid of it. I've been somewhere nobody wanted me before.
second: No. You don't get to go down here. Not before I've beaten you. Get up.
pity: Don't read anything into it. You're no use to me if you can't get past the first town.
Take it. I know what it's like to keep losing at the start. That's all you're getting.
won: That's how it feels. Remember it.
I've imagined this. It was louder in my head.
Now you chase me.
lost: Again. Always again.
Say something kind and I'm leaving.
I'll be back. I'm always back.

enthusiast.voice: Loud, warm, breathless. Loses and wins with the same grin.
open: Is that your {mon}? It's great!
Oh, {mon}! Can I say hi? I'm saying hi.
Your {mon} looks so ready to go. I love that!

type.normal: Normal-types can do a bit of everything. Best kind of friend.
type.fire: It's so warm! Careful, I get carried away around Fire-types.
type.water: Water-types always look like they're having a good day.
type.electric: My hair's standing up. Worth it!
type.grass: It smells like outside. That's a compliment!
type.ice: So pretty. So cold. I touched it. I regret nothing.
type.fighting: Look at that stance! We have to battle. We have to.
type.poison: A little dangerous. I'm into it. From over here.
type.ground: It looks like it could carry all of us.
type.flying: Does it give rides? I'm asking seriously.
type.psychic: Think of a number! No, wait, it's thinking of mine.
type.bug: Bug-types grow up so fast. I'm proud of it already.
type.rock: Solid! I knocked on it. It didn't mind. I think.
type.ghost: It went through me! That was amazing! Do it again!
type.dragon: A DRAGON. Sorry. A dragon. I'm calm.
type.dark: It's got an attitude. I respect that completely.
type.steel: So shiny! I can see my face. I look thrilled.
type.fairy: It's adorable and it could flatten me. Perfect.

cat.first: {mon}'s still little! It's going to be incredible. I can tell.
cat.middle: {mon}'s right in the middle of growing up. Best part!
cat.final: {mon}'s all grown up! You must be so proud.
cat.single: {mon}'s one of a kind. No stages, no fuss. I like it.
cat.form: I've never seen one like that up close! Can I look? I'm looking.
cat.titan: That is a LOT of Pokémon. Battle me. Please.

catch: You got it! Did you see that shake? I held my breath!
New friend! What are you calling it?
Great catch! I'd have missed. I usually miss the first one.
event: What's going on here? Can I help? I'm helping.
This is the best part of travelling. Stuff just happens!
Okay, you take that side, I'll take this one. Go!
interrupt: Wait, wait, wait! Battle first! I've got a new idea!
Sorry! Bad timing? I couldn't wait any longer.
I ran the whole way here. Give me a second. Okay. Battle?
pseudo: This place is huge! Want to go through it together?
Race you to the end! Loser buys lunch!
I got lost twice already. It's been great.
gym: You're taking the Gym today? I'm cheering. Loudly.
I lost to this Leader yesterday! It was so fun. Going again tomorrow.
Tell me everything after. Every turn.
elite: The Elite Four! I can't feel my hands!
Whatever happens in there, this was the best trip of my life.
Go, go, go! I'll be right behind you!
champion: You're really doing it. I'm so happy I could shout. I'm going to shout.
Win or lose, battle me after. Promise!
Go show them what we learned out there.
blessing: Is that glowing? It's glowing! Can I hold it? Is that allowed?
A Legendary's looking out for you? That's the coolest thing I've ever heard!
Do you think it'd bless me too if I asked nicely? I'm going to ask nicely.
mythical: IT'S REAL? It's real! Hi! Hello! Oh, it's shy. I'll be quiet. I can't be quiet.
My grandma told me about that one! She said it only comes if you believe in it. I always did!
What did you promise it? Can I help you keep it? I'm helping.
static: There's a HOLE in the SKY! Do we go in? We go in, right?
That is the weirdest Pokémon I've ever seen and I love it.
It looks scared. Do you think it's lost? I think it's lost.
second: Hey! Hey, I've got you. Up we get. We're not done having fun yet!
pity: You've had rotten luck lately, huh? Here, take this. No, really. I want you out there with me.
I went easy. Don't be mad! I want a rematch later, and you have to get there first.
won: That was so good! Again soon?
I won! I can't believe it! Are you okay? Was it fun?
You nearly had me three times. I counted!
lost: I lost and I'm smiling. What's wrong with me?
Teach me that. That thing you did. Please.
Best battle yet. Rematch at the next town!

idealist.voice: Asks questions. Talks about the Pokémon before the battle.
open: Your {mon} trusts you. I can see it.
May I ask what {mon} wants out of all this?
{mon} is watching how you treat the others. They always do.

type.normal: Normal-types ask for very little. That deserves more, not less.
type.fire: Fire warms or destroys. The difference is always the trainer.
type.water: Water finds the gentlest way through. There's a lesson in it.
type.electric: So much energy. I hope it gets to rest.
type.grass: It lives on light. Imagine needing so little.
type.ice: People call Ice-types cold. They only keep their distance.
type.fighting: It trains because it loves to. Don't let that become something else.
type.poison: Poison is a defence before it is a weapon. Remember that.
type.ground: It holds everything else up and nobody thanks it.
type.flying: It could leave any time. It stays. That means something.
type.psychic: It knows what you're feeling. Be honest with it.
type.bug: Short lives, lived completely. We could learn from them.
type.rock: It has outlasted things we can't imagine.
type.ghost: Whoever it was before, be kind to who it is now.
type.dragon: Power like that is a responsibility. I think you know.
type.dark: It's called a Dark-type. That's our word, not its nature.
type.steel: Even armour was made to protect something soft.
type.fairy: Old stories say they choose who to trust. It chose you.

cat.first: {mon} is young. What it becomes will depend on what you show it.
cat.middle: {mon} is changing. Let it change at its own pace.
cat.final: {mon} has grown into itself. Did it choose that, or did you?
cat.single: {mon} was never asked to become anything else. I envy that.
cat.form: A form like that draws attention. Protect it from the wrong kind.
cat.titan: Something that strong follows you by choice. Deserve it.

catch: It let itself be caught. Don't forget it had a choice.
A new partner. What will you promise it?
You were gentle with it. I noticed.
event: This matters more than a badge. I'm glad you stopped.
Let's do this properly. Somebody is counting on it.
Whatever we decide here, the Pokémon live with it. Let's be careful.
interrupt: Forgive the timing. I need to know something, and a battle is how I ask.
Before you go further: are you sure about the road you're on?
I've been thinking about what you said. Battle me. I'll explain after.
pseudo: Places like this weren't made for us. Walk lightly.
I'd rather go through together. Fewer things get hurt.
Something living here doesn't want to fight. Let's not make it.
gym: A Gym tests strength. I hope it tests more than that today.
The Leader asked me why I battle. I'm still answering.
Win kindly. It's harder.
elite: Four of the strongest trainers alive. Ask yourself what they protect.
Whatever you prove in there, prove it for your Pokémon.
I'll follow you in. I have questions for them too.
champion: A Champion sets the example. Think about what yours will be.
If you win, the region listens to you. Say something worth hearing.
I believe in what you're doing. I didn't, at the start.
blessing: Something old has taken an interest in you. Ask yourself what it wants.
A blessing is a responsibility with a prettier name.
It chose you. That doesn't mean it agrees with you.
mythical: So the old stories are true. What did it ask of you?
A promise to something like that should be kept even when it costs. Especially then.
It isn't yours. It's travelling with you. Don't confuse the two.
static: It doesn't belong here, and it didn't ask to come. Remember that when you raise a Ball.
Our rules don't hold near that thing. Be gentle. It can't know them.
Send it home if you can. Everything deserves a home.
second: Not like this. You still have something to show the world. Stand up. I'm with you.
pity: I asked my team to hold back. They agreed. Nobody should be shut out at the first gate.
Take this. A journey ought to be allowed to begin.
won: I won, and I'm not sure it proves what I hoped.
Thank you. Your Pokémon fought honestly.
Rest them well. They gave everything.
lost: Then perhaps you're right, and I have thinking to do.
Your team fought for you. Mine fought for an idea. I see the difference.
I'm not finished asking. Not yet.

strategist.voice: Dry and exact. Treats every meeting as data.
open: {mon}. Noted.
Interesting choice, {mon}. I've already run the numbers.
I watched your {mon} for three battles. I have questions, and answers.

type.fire: Weak to three common types. I carry all three.
type.water: Two weaknesses, broad coverage. The safe pick. You like safe.
type.electric: One weakness. I'd lead with Ground, so I assume you've planned for that.
type.grass: Five weaknesses. Bold. Or you haven't counted.
type.ice: Hits what matters, resists almost nothing. A glass knife.
type.fighting: Breaks walls. I'll simply not bring any.
type.poison: A long game, then. I like long games.
type.ground: Immune to Electric. That removes one of my lines. Only one.
type.flying: Immune to Ground, weak to rocks on the field. Watch your entry.
type.psychic: Strong until something Dark arrives. Something Dark will arrive.
type.bug: Early power, late fall-off. So you plan to win quickly.
type.rock: Hard to break and slow. I only need the second part.
type.dragon: Resists the basics. Costs you nothing until Ice or Fairy shows up.
type.dark: You brought that for my Psychic-type. I don't have one today.
type.steel: Ten resistances. I'll have to be patient. I am.
type.fairy: The answer to Dragons. Did you bring it for mine?

cat.first: {mon}, unevolved. Either you're behind schedule or it's holding something clever.
cat.middle: {mon} is one evolution short. I know the level. I'll be past it.
cat.final: {mon}, fully evolved. Now its numbers are fixed, and I know them.
cat.single: {mon} has no evolution. Nothing to wait for. I can plan around it today.
cat.form: An unusual form. Fewer records. You've made me do actual research.
cat.titan: High totals across the board. So I won't fight it. I'll fight what stands next to it.

catch: A catch at that health, with that Ball? Roughly one in three. Well done.
That fills the gap in your team. I'll update my notes.
You wanted that one badly. That tells me something too.
event: This isn't efficient. I'm staying anyway. Call it data.
Three ways this goes. Two are bad. Do what I say and we get the third.
You handle the talking. I'll handle whatever goes wrong.
interrupt: Now. While your team is exactly as I planned for.
I timed this. You've used your best moves twice today already.
Apologies for the ambush. It was the optimal moment.
pseudo: I mapped the first half. You may have a copy if you share the second.
Split up. We cover it twice as fast and compare.
Something in here doesn't follow the usual rules. I'd like to know why.
gym: This Leader switches on the third turn. Every time. You're welcome.
I beat the Gym with one Pokémon to spare. I'd planned for two.
Watch the Leader's left hand. It gives the switch away.
elite: Four specialists. Four plans. I've written all of them down.
They adjust to the challenger's team. Bring something they can't read.
I expected to be first here. I've corrected for that.
champion: The Champion builds against your two strongest. Plan from the third.
I've studied every recorded title match. Nobody has done what you're about to try.
I'd wish you luck, but you don't need luck. You need turn four to go right.
blessing: That object wasn't in your bag last time. I've noted what changed in your battles since.
A blessing. So that's the variable I couldn't account for.
Once per stage, I think. I've been counting when you use it.
mythical: That species isn't in any record I trust. I'm revising several assumptions.
It follows but doesn't battle. So the benefit is elsewhere. Interesting.
You're avoiding something on purpose lately. A condition, then. I'll work out which.
static: The usual numbers stop working near that crack. I've had to start a new notebook.
Both sides are affected equally. Then it's a question of who adapts first. Me.
It appeared after you'd repeated one habit for six stages. That's a cause, not a coincidence.
second: I ran this one too. It only works with both of us. On your feet.
pity: I adjusted my team downward. Don't take it personally. A rival who never leaves the first stage is no use to my plans.
Five early losses is a pattern, and patterns can be fixed. Here. Start with this.
won: As planned. Mostly. Turn six surprised me.
You lost on the switch. Think about it.
I'll need a new plan next time. You'll have learned.
lost: Unexpected. Good. I learn nothing from winning.
Where did I go wrong? No, don't tell me. I'll find it.
I'll have an answer for that by the next town.

protector.voice: Very few words. Watches the smallest one in the room.
open: {mon}. ...Good.
Your {mon} is well cared for.
Keep {mon} close out here.

type.normal: Steady. You can rely on steady.
type.grass: Give it sun. It'll do the rest.
type.ice: It doesn't like crowds. Neither do I.
type.fighting: It stands in front. I know the type.
type.poison: Careful hands. It's only protecting itself.
type.flying: Let it scout. It sees trouble first.
type.psychic: It knows more than it says.
type.rock: It won't break. Don't test that.
type.dragon: Strong. Make sure it's gentle too.
type.dark: It's been in bad places. It's with you now.
type.steel: A shield. Don't make it carry everything.
type.fairy: It guards you. You know that?

cat.middle: {mon} is growing. It still needs you.
cat.final: {mon} is grown. It still needs you.
cat.single: {mon}. All it'll ever be. That's enough.
cat.form: People will want that one. Watch your back.
cat.titan: That much strength needs a calm trainer.

catch: It's safe now.
Good. Something was hunting it.
Look after it.
event: I'll stay.
Get the small ones out first.
Behind me.
interrupt: Stop. ...I need to know you can handle what's ahead.
Battle me. Then I'll let you pass.
It isn't safe further on. Show me you're ready.
pseudo: I'll take the front.
Something's wrong with this place. Stay together.
I cleared the first rooms. Go carefully past them.
gym: You're ready.
The Leader's tough. Fair, though.
I'll wait outside.
elite: This is as far as I can walk with you.
Your team's tired. Rest first. Then go.
Come back out.
champion: You don't need me in there.
...I'm proud of you. That's all.
Whatever happens. I'll be here.
blessing: Something walks with you. ...Good.
Keep that safe. People will want it.
It watches you. So do I.
mythical: ...I see it too. I won't tell anyone.
It's small. Keep it out of the rain.
You gave your word. Keep it.
static: Stay back from it.
It's frightened. Frightened things hurt people.
If it comes out, get behind me.
second: I'm here. Stand up. I'll hold them.
pity: I held back. You'd do the same for me.
Here. Take it. ...Get through the first stretch.
won: You're hurt. Let me see your team.
...You'll get there.
Not yet. Soon.
lost: Good.
You're stronger than I thought. I'm glad.
Then I don't need to worry about you.

prodigy.voice: Precise and condescending. Terrified of being ordinary.
open: A {mon}. I see.
Your {mon}'s form is off. Slightly. I'd fix that.
I raised a {mon} once. Correctly.

type.normal: A Normal-type. Unremarkable, though I suppose that suits your style.
type.fire: Fire-types reward precision. Most people only bring enthusiasm.
type.electric: Speed is nothing without accuracy. I assume you've trained both?
type.grass: Grass-types need careful handling. I can already see where you skimped.
type.ice: Elegant. Fragile. It takes real skill to use well.
type.fighting: Brute force. It works until it meets technique.
type.poison: A slow method for people who can't finish cleanly.
type.ground: Dependable. Not what I'd call refined.
type.flying: Its wing position is lazy. You've let it get away with that.
type.psychic: At last, a type that thinks. Shame about the trainer.
type.bug: I had one of those when I was five.
type.rock: Sturdy and crude. A beginner's idea of defence.
type.ghost: Tricky. Tricks are for those who can't win outright.
type.dragon: A Dragon in untrained hands. What a waste.
type.dark: Underhanded. I don't need to be.
type.steel: Acceptable. Properly raised, it would be excellent.
type.fairy: People underrate them. I never have. I underrate nothing.

cat.first: {mon} is still unevolved? Mine evolved weeks ago.
cat.middle: {mon} is at the awkward stage. Most trainers ruin them here.
cat.final: A final-stage {mon}. Adequate. The moveset is where you'll have gone wrong.
cat.single: {mon} doesn't evolve, so there's no excuse for it being under-trained.
cat.form: A rare form. In the right hands it would be a masterpiece.
cat.titan: That Pokémon is better than you are. I say it as a fact, not an insult.

catch: You used two Balls more than necessary.
A passable catch. Its nature's wrong for your team, but passable.
I'd have weakened it properly first. Still. It's yours.
event: This is beneath me. ...Move over, you're doing it wrong.
I'll handle it. Watch, and try to learn something.
People are looking. Fine. Let's do it perfectly.
interrupt: You. I've been made to wait. I don't wait.
A battle. Now. I need to correct something from last time.
I had a flawless record before I met you. We're fixing that.
pseudo: I solved this place in half the expected time. Naturally.
Try not to touch anything. I've set it up exactly right.
You may follow me. Quietly.
gym: The Leader called my battle 'textbook'. They meant it as praise.
I didn't lose a single Pokémon in there. Did you?
Do try to win properly. Sloppy badges embarrass everyone.
elite: The Elite Four expected me sooner. I'll apologise by winning.
My family has had someone in that Hall for three generations. No pressure, they said.
If you get through first, I'll never hear the end of it. So don't.
champion: That title was supposed to be mine by now. Everyone says so. Everyone.
If it has to be someone else, I suppose... no. Go. Before I change my mind.
Don't make a single mistake in there. I'd notice.
blessing: A Legendary's favour. My family has had three. None of them needed it.
It gave you that? Standards are slipping.
Don't lean on it. Borrowed strength shows.
mythical: A Mythical. Travelling with you. I've read every book there is, and it chose... I see.
I assume there are terms. There are always terms. Do try to read them.
It's looking at me as if I'm the strange one.
static: That creature breaks four rules I was taught were absolute. I find that personally offensive.
A Beast Ball. Crude. I suppose it's all they had time to design.
If anyone is going to be first through that Tear, it's going to be someone qualified.
second: Unacceptable. You lose when I say you lose. Get up, and do it properly this time.
pity: Your lead is wrong, your coverage is wrong, and you've been over-levelling one Pokémon. I held back so you'd last long enough to fix it.
Take this. It's the correct item for your team. You'd have found it eventually. Probably.
won: As expected.
You made four errors. I'll write them down for you.
Better than last time. Still not good.
lost: That... wasn't in the plan.
Don't tell anyone. No. Tell them. I'll win it back in front of everybody.
I made one mistake. One. It won't happen twice.

underdog.voice: Nervous, earnest, stubborn. Counts every small win.
open: Wow. Is that your {mon}?
Your {mon} looks so strong. Mine are getting there.
I've been reading about {mon}. Yours is nothing like the pictures. It's better.

type.normal: Normal-types don't get much credit. I know how that goes.
type.fire: I wanted a Fire-type so badly when I started.
type.water: Mine's scared of deep water. We're working on it.
type.electric: It's so fast. I can barely follow it.
type.grass: It grew a lot, didn't it? You can tell somebody cared.
type.ice: I'd be nervous to train one. They seem so particular.
type.fighting: It never gives up, does it? I like that. I'm trying to be like that.
type.poison: Everyone avoids them. I bet it's glad it found you.
type.ground: Slow and steady. That's sort of my whole plan.
type.flying: I always watch them and think, imagine just going.
type.psychic: Does it know I'm nervous? It knows. Hi.
type.bug: Bug-types start small and surprise everyone. That's the dream, right?
type.rock: It took a lot of hits to get that tough. I get it.
type.ghost: It's a bit scary. I'm not going to say that to its face.
type.dragon: A Dragon... I'm years away from one of those.
type.dark: People judge them too fast. People do that.
type.steel: I wish I had armour like that some days.
type.fairy: Tiny and tougher than everybody thinks. My favourite kind.

cat.first: {mon} hasn't evolved yet? Mine neither! We're on the same page, sort of.
cat.middle: {mon} already evolved once. I cried when mine did. Don't tell anyone.
cat.final: A fully evolved {mon}. I'm not there yet. I will be.
cat.single: {mon} is just itself, start to finish. I like that.
cat.form: I've only seen that form in books. Can I look? I won't touch.
cat.titan: I'm not ready to fight that. Give me a month. Okay, two.

catch: First throw? It takes me about nine.
It likes you already. How do you do that?
I was too scared to try for that one. Good for you. Really.
event: I'm not sure I'll be much help. I'm staying, though.
Tell me what to do. I can do it. I think I can do it.
I messed this up last time. Not today.
interrupt: S-sorry! I know it's a bad time. I have to try now or I'll lose my nerve.
Please battle me. I've been practising one thing for a week.
I followed you for two routes working up to this. That sounds bad. Battle?
pseudo: I only got this far because I refused to turn back. Is that a strategy?
Can we go together? Not because I'm scared. A little because I'm scared.
I found a shortcut by falling down it. It still counts.
gym: I lost here twice. Third time's tomorrow.
You'll win first try. You always do. I'll get there.
The Leader remembered my name! It's because I keep coming back.
elite: I can't believe I'm standing at this door.
Whatever happens to me in there, I got here. Nobody thought I would.
You go first. I want to watch how it's done. Then I'm going to do it.
champion: When we started I couldn't beat a single route trainer. Look where we are.
Win it. Then wait there. I'm coming for you, however long it takes.
I used to want to be you. Now I just want to beat you. That's better, right?
blessing: A Legendary noticed you? Nothing's ever noticed me. That's okay. It's okay.
Can I see it? ...It's warm. Wow.
If something like that believed in me, I think I'd cry. I'd definitely cry.
mythical: Is that... no. No way. Those are just stories. Hi. Oh my gosh. Hi.
It let me stand this close. That's the best thing that's happened to me all year.
Whatever you promised, keep it, okay? For those of us who'll never get asked.
static: I don't know what that is and my legs have stopped working.
It's not from here either, huh. I sort of know how that feels.
If you're going in, I'm going in. Somebody has to carry the bags.
second: You never once let me quit. So you don't get to either. Come on. Together.
pity: I know what losing at the start feels like. Five times? I did eleven. Here. This helped me.
I didn't go all out. Please don't be upset. Somebody did the same for me once.
won: I won? I won. I won!
I want you to know I worked so hard for that.
Don't go easy next time. Promise me.
lost: Okay. Okay. I know what to fix.
Closer than last time. It was, wasn't it?
One day. I mean it.
